internal_clinic_hub.core_philosophy: Operational density, fast access, high-contrast data display, progressive disclosure, minimal unnecessary whitespace. Must feel like a modernized desktop application, preserving the MS Access VISITA visual identity (light blue workspace, green functional modules).

patient_portal.core_philosophy: Clean, friendly, simple, highly accessible. Large touch targets, plain wording, low cognitive load, minimal options. Should feel welcoming and reassuring.

internal_clinic_hub.reasoning: Technical, highly legible at small sizes, excellent for dense data tables and fast scanning.

patient_portal.reasoning: Friendly, rounded terminals, approachable, and highly readable for older users.

internal_clinic_hub.shadows: shadow-sm (only to separate overlapping panels or modals, flat UI preferred for dense data)
internal_clinic_hub.borders: 1px solid border-slate-300 on cards and table rows to explicitly define boundaries.

patient_portal.shadows: shadow-md (soft ambient shadows to make actionable tiles pop)
patient_portal.borders: border-slate-100 to border-slate-200, subtle to maintain softness.

internal_clinic_hub.live_actionable_counters: Must be rectangular, compact height (e.g., h-16), background white, with a thick green left border (border-l-4 border-[#2E8540]). Number should be text-2xl or 3xl font-bold text-slate-900. Label text-xs uppercase text-slate-600. Hover state: bg-slate-50 border-[#246B33].
internal_clinic_hub.data_tables_queues: Extremely dense. py-1.5 px-2 for cells. Use border-collapse with border-b border-slate-200. text-sm. Striped rows (even:bg-slate-50) for fast scanning. Row hover: hover:bg-[#E6F0FA] (light blue highlight).
internal_clinic_hub.buttons: Rectangular, rounded-sm, px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium. Primary buttons in VISITA Green (#2E8540) with text-white.
internal_clinic_hub.navigation: Persistent left sidebar or dense top ribbon. No hamburger menus on desktop. Immediate visibility of all primary queues.

patient_portal.action_tiles: Large, square or wide-rectangular touch targets. rounded-2xl, p-6, shadow-md, bg-white. Centered layout: large friendly icon (text-blue-500) above text-lg font-bold. Active scale-down on click (active:scale-95).
patient_portal.bottom_navigation: fixed bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-slate-200 shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]. Flex justify-around. Min touch target 48px height. Active states highlighted with primary color.
patient_portal.disclaimer_banner: bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-200 flex items-start gap-2. Prominent but not alarming.

internal_clinic_hub.layout_strategy: CSS Grid for macro layout (e.g., grid-cols-12). Subgrids for complex forms. Avoid container padding larger than p-4.
internal_clinic_hub.spacing: Tight scale: gap-2, p-2, p-3. Maximize viewport utilization.
internal_clinic_hub.alignment: Left-align dense data, right-align numbers/currencies. Top-align labels in forms to save horizontal space.

patient_portal.layout_strategy: Single column mobile-first (flex-col). On desktop, constrain max-width to max-w-md or max-w-lg and center it to maintain the app-like feel.
patient_portal.spacing: Generous scale: gap-4, p-6, p-8. Let elements breathe.
patient_portal.alignment: Center-align text in action tiles. Left-align body content for readability.

internal_clinic_hub.transitions: Instant or extremely fast. duration-75 or duration-100 ease-in-out. Purely functional hover states (color changes). No scaling or bouncy animations.

patient_portal.transitions: Smooth and welcoming. duration-200 or duration-300 ease-out. Use gentle scaling for button presses (active:scale-95). List items can have a subtle staggered fade-in.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance for both personas. Internal hub text must be dark gray/black against the light blue/white backgrounds.
accessibility.touch_targets: Patient Portal MUST have minimum 48x48px touch targets for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='patient-appointment-btn', data-testid='rx-counter').
accessibility.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers, overlays, or surfaces with content underneath.

media.strategy: Use clean, professional medical imagery sparingly. Internal hub uses almost no imagery, heavily reliant on dense UI and Phosphor icons. Patient portal uses friendly, approachable icons (Lucide/Phosphor) and selective high-quality imagery.

doctor_portrait_male.description: Friendly male doctor portrait for portal.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx extensions exclusively. Do NOT use .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing_strategy: Implement distinct routing layouts for '/internal/*' (Desktop EMR Hub) and '/portal/*' (Mobile Patient Portal).
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Create custom raw Tailwind HTML for the dense Internal tables/counters to avoid Shadcn's default padding/margins. Use customized Shadcn for Patient Portal forms/dialogs.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling: Inject IBM Plex Sans and Nunito via Google Fonts in index.html or global css. Extend tailwind.config.js to include the custom VISITA colors (internal-bg: #E6F0FA, visita-green: #2E8540).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: Enforce data-testid attributes on every clickable item, navigation link, table row action, and form input.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic placeholder text for images; if image_urls are provided, use them.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep the internal hub flat and functional.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS (e.g., .App { text-align: center; }).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards, and Lucide React (lucide-react) for the patient portal.
Use 'sonner' for toasts notifications. They are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, adjusting their classes as needed for the dense vs. mobile-first contexts.
